overall_reason: The 'Upload file' to 'Uploaded' label travels as one 28 px track on a 480 ms ease-out, which is continuity, but the label window has hard edges that slice both labels mid-roll.

score.reason: T-CONTINUITY fails because the window's edges cut the text; T-MOTION-SYSTEM and T-PURPOSE pass for the single track.

findings.where: span.ed-label-window (88 by 28 px, overflow hidden) in div.ed-button, 1440
findings.evidence: In the 1609 ms still dark glyph pixels (luminance 55 and 54) sit on the window's first and last rows (y 38 and y 65): the top of 'Upload file' and the bottom of 'Uploaded' are cut off by straight edges. The window declares overflow: hidden and no mask.
findings.before: Hard-edged 28 px window during the roll
findings.after: Mask the window's top and bottom 6 px with a linear-gradient so the labels fade at the edges as they pass
findings.why: Text sliced by a straight edge reads as a rendering fault, not as a label changing.

strengths: Both labels move on one track (span.ed-label-track, transform 0.48 s on cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)) and the button holds 112 px, so nothing outside the label moves.
not_investigated: Frame-level timing: the passive stills are seven shots over 6 s from a separate load, so durations and curves come from the declarations at 1440, not from frames between stills.
Sweep motion (MOT-002) is not-verified: motion capture was skipped (--no-motion) and there were no click runs; async_state (CMP-001) is not-verified (--no-async).
T-RAPID-TOGGLE and interruptibility: no detector built and no click runs.
Gestures and drags as a person plays them, scroll-driven motion, hover as it plays (only declarations read), and route or page transitions: not captured.
The shared stylesheet's 8 motion_css (MOT-001) hits belong to the sweep and are not repeated here.
